newsitem.title: USA: IMC Global completes Crop-Maker acquisition.
newsitem.headline: IMC Global completes Crop-Maker acquisition.

text.p: IMC Global Inc on Tuesday said its retail and wholesale business unit, IMC AgriBusiness Inc, completed the previously announced acquisition of Crop-Maker Soil Service Inc of Indiana.
Privately owned Crop-Maker, with annual sales of about $11 million, operates four retail farm service centers in north central Indiana and a fifth in the southwestern part of the state.
The acquisition increases the number of IMC AgriBusiness retail farm centers to almost 225.
IMC Global produces and markets phosphate and potash crop nutrients and animal feed ingredients.
